description:
Render a tarot reading PDF. Default spread `three-card` (Past/Present/Future from Rider-Waite-Smith deck). Available spreads: single-card, three-card, celtic-cross, horseshoe, relationship, year-ahead, decision, chakra, career, love-triangle. Pass `seed` for reproducibility (deterministic mulberry32 RNG); omit to use a daily seed. Set `allowReversed: false` to draw upright cards only.

[Group: Reports]
[Endpoint: POST /v1/reports/tarot]
[Cost: 100 credits (Tier 4)]

format.description: `pdf` (default) stores a PDF and answers with its `url`. `html` returns one self-contained `text/html` document, `markdown` returns `text/markdown` with the same sections and tables; neither is stored. Same price in every format.

headingColor.description: Colour of the divider rule under each section heading (not the heading text, which is themeColor).

themeColor.description: Accent colour, used for section heading text and inline emphasis.

name: astroway_reports_tarot
title: Generate Tarot Reading (PDF or HTML)
